def grid_cell_index(row, col, width):
    """Determine the flat storage position of a cell in a rectangular grid
    whose rows are laid out consecutively in row-major order. Under this
    arrangement, the cells of row 0 occupy the first width positions of the
    flattened sequence, the cells of row 1 occupy the next width positions,
    and so on, so that each cell corresponds to exactly one flat position.
    row, col, width are ints with width >= 1, 0 <= col < width, and
    row >= 0. Return the 0-based flat index of the cell, computed as
    row * width + col exactly. The calculation therefore reduces to a
    single arithmetic evaluation over the given integers.

    >>> grid_cell_index(0, 0, 1)
    0
    >>> grid_cell_index(2, 3, 5)
    13
    """
